description_en: Updates the information about a product version
kebab_example: aliyun servicecatalog update-product-version --product-version-id pv-bp15e79d260000 --product-version-name 1.0 --description This_is_a_product_version_description. --guidance Default --active true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProductVersion

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product version
parameters.name: product_version_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the product version.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本名称。

长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: product_version_name

parameters.example: This is a product version description.
parameters.help_en:
The description of the product version.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本描述。

长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The recommendation information. Valid values:

- Default: No recommendation information is provided. This is the default value.

- Recommended: the recommended version.

- Latest: the latest version.

- Deprecated: the version that is about to be discontinued
parameters.help_zh:
推荐信息。取值：

- Default（默认值）：无。
- Recommended：稳定版。
- Latest：最新版。
- Deprecated：将废弃
parameters.name: guidance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the product version. Valid values:

- true: enables the product version. This is the default value.

- false: disables the product version
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：

- true（默认值）：启用。
- false：禁用
parameters.name: active
